5056095713306.variantName: True Products 7ft Pre-Lit Norwegian Fir Artificial Christmas Tree - Multi Colour & Warm White Lights
5056095713306.sourceDescription:
Set the scene for a cosy Christmas with our Pre-Lit Norwegian Fir Christmas Tree. Its traditional silhouette and combination of multi colour or warm white LED lights bring a welcoming glow to your home, ready for festive evenings and family celebrations. Available heights, 6ft and 7ft.

This Norwegian Fir combines realistic PE tips with PVC tips. The mixed tips give the foliage texture and depth, creating a natural-looking setting for treasured ornaments and your chosen Christmas colour scheme.

With the lights already fitted, you can get straight to the enjoyable part of decorating. Choose a steady glow for relaxed evenings, a little twinkle for festive sparkle or a gentle slow fade. There are 9 multifunction settings to choose from, with the lights mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's shape, then finish with your favourite baubles, ribbons and tree topper.

Features:
 Light functions: 9 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 138cm
Tip count: 1575 (703 PE and 872 PVC)
Lights: 650 multi colour LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

The decorative form gives the arrangement a clear point of interest. Position it alongside surrounding colours and textures, allowing the shape and proportions to remain visible without crowding the display.

For routine care, remove dust gently using a method suited to the stated material. When storing seasonal decorations, protect projecting details and keep related pieces together so the arrangement can be set out again.

The item is a decorative accessory for the described display. Choose its position according to its construction and stated conditions of use rather than assuming that every decorative piece is suitable for outdoor exposure or play.

8956086440006.sourceDescription:
A 31.5 inch plush tree skirt in red and white, soft enough that it gets used as a mat for the cat within a week. Small enough for a tabletop tree, big enough to hide a stand.

The plush is short and dense, so it does not shed all over the carpet, and the cut seam at the back lets you open it and fit it round the trunk. It suits trees under about 1.5 m, which covers most of the slim and potted ones sold for small rooms. Give it a shake to fluff it up before use; spot clean or hand wash cold, then air dry.

Red and white is the classic pairing, and it does not need any other decoration to make sense.

Material: Plush fabric
31.5 inch red and white plush skirt
Short dense pile that does not shed on carpet
Cut seam at the back to fit round the trunk
Suits trees under about 1.5 m tall
Shake to fluff, spot clean or hand wash cold
For Indoor & outdoor Use

Christmas Tree Topper
This Christmas tree topper adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and iron construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Material: Iron. Colour: Gold. Product measurements: length 21 cm, width 19 cm, height 4 cm. Product weight: 0.23 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Durable iron construction provides a defined shape that holds its form for repeated seasonal use.
Light-catching glitter surface enhances the festive atmosphere and pairs well with plain ornaments.

5056903233606.sourceDescription:
Bring red foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 12 artificial fern garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Feathery fronds with narrow leaflets branch along the garland, creating an open foliage outline with a glittered surface. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the red colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 12 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Fern Garland: Includes 12 matching red artificial fern leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Feathery fronds with narrow leaflets branch along the garland, creating an open foliage outline with a glittered surface. The red colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the red fern foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 12 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

5056797097506.sourceDescription:
Light up the season with this pre-lit Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. Fine branches burst outwards like a display, each one lit with copper gold micro LEDs for a warm, sparkling glow that instantly brings festive magic to your home or garden. It is available in 1.5m with 2000 micro LEDs or 1.8m with 3000 micro LEDs, so you can choose the right size for your space. The durable black frame disappears into the background after dark, leaving just the shimmering lights on show. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, it makes a striking feature in living rooms, hallways and conservatories, or on patios and porches. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. Its stitched pattern works with dark clothing and other separately supplied accessories, giving your outfit a distinct light-up feature in party photographs.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Prepare your home perfectly for the Christmas season with the artificial Christmas tree Prancer from tectake. The artificial fir tree immediately impresses with its rich green colour and creates a festive atmosphere that makes any living room shine.

The artificial Christmas tree is not only a visual highlight but also extremely practical. Thanks to the trees well-thought-out plug-in mechanism, assembly is easy and takes just a few minutes. This saves you valuable time that you can instead spend on adding decorations to your tree. The stable stand made of powder-coated steel with its floor-friendly plastic feet ensures a secure and firm hold, even after you add baubles, fairy lights and other decorations.

Durable and easy to care for.

With the artificial Christmas tree, you are investing in a tree that will last for many years. Made from high-quality, robust materials, it is particularly durable and looks as good as new year after year. The innovative combination of PVC and injection-moulded needles gives the tree the best, most deceptively natural appearance. This way, you bring the charm of a real Christmas tree into your home, without the annoying loss of needles.

Another advantage of this tree is its space-saving storage. After the holidays, it can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. This way, it takes up little space and can be set up again just as quickly next year.
